title: Ukraine denies Seoul claim on North Korean POW transfer

blocks.text: Kyiv has denied Seoul’s claim that the two parties agreed to keep the recent transfer of two North Korean prisoners-of-war to South Korea confidential, sparking criticism from President Lee Jae Myung’s political opponents. Regarding Seoul’s claim that Kyiv had broken their consensus, Dmytro Lytvyn, communications adviser to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said Friday, “There was no such agreement, this is not true.” “And it would be wrong to conceal the whereabouts of specific prisoners,” Lytvyn also wrote.
